desc: Desktop co-op: player 1 on the keyboard and controller 1; a second controller plugged in is nobody until its Start (its stick and A before that join nothing, co-op stays off); its Start makes it player 2 (port 2), controller 1 staying player 1; player 2 walks and hops the partner (each hop back to standing: the playtest's partner stuck mid-jump); player 2 asks for seat 1 in their own menu (Who's who), player 1 says yes on the keyboard: the controllers and the keyboard trade ports; player 1 (now controller 2) walks, player 2 hops; swapped back the same way; controller 2 switched off: its seat frees, back to one player
